apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata:
  name: require-labels
spec:
  rules:
  - name: check-owner
    match:
      resources:
        kinds:
        - Pod
    validate:
      message: "label 'owner' is required"
      pattern:
        metadata:
          labels:
            owner: "*?*"
EOF
kubectl apply -f kyverno-policy.yaml
